items.cn: 你上次对姐妹大喊大叫是什么时候?
items.ans:
l remembered l
shouted at my sister last weekend because my sister tore my drawing
book and threw it into the garbage basket. l was very angry.l shouted at
her and she cried loudly. My mum heard her cry and came to see what
happened.When my mum got to know what happened, she took my
sister away and bought me a new drawing book the next day.

items.q: Do you think you can be a leader for a group of twenty people?
items.cn: 你认为你能成为二十人小组的领导吗?
items.ans:
Yes,l think l can be a leader for a group of twenty people.l know
it re-quires an outstanding interpersonal skill. l have taken part in a
training courseto develop my communication skills so that l can handle
the problems people raise when they meet difficulties.l also want to take
a chance to work together with others and get along well with them.
Or: No,i don't think l can be a leader for a group of twenty people. lt's a
demanding job to be a leader.You have to be very skilful to
communicate with so many people.I'm not that kind of person to
communicate smoothly with others. So l don't think l can handle
people's problems effectively.

items.q: What do you have to do when you are asked to a party or other events?
items.cn: 当你被邀请参加晚会或其他活动 时,你需要做什么?
items.ans:
When l'm asked to a party or other events,l
have to prepare it very wel.Firstly,l need to know who will participate in
the party. Secondly, l should make sure when and where the party will be
held. Thirdly,l must know whether l have to pay for it or not. lt's always a
good idea to bring some cash.Otherwise,l will lose my face there.

l'm a new person in the project,l hope other

items.q: What's your favourite sport?
items.cn: 你最喜欢的运动是什么?
items.ans:
My favourite sport is football /soccer /baseball. L like football
/soccer /baseball very much and l can play it well with my friends and my
classmates.What's more,l always win the game, so l think l can be a good
player in the future.

items.q: Which is more important, winning or losing in sports?
items.cn: 在体育运动中,输和赢哪个更重要?
items.ans:
l think winning is more important. Everybody wants to win the
game andnobody wants to lose. This is why sports competition is always
fairly fierce.However, people like to watch intense competitions. When
there is not a hotcompetition,the game is usually boring.
Or:l don't think it matters so much if we win the sports game. There is
always winning or losing in a sports game. When we win, we're happy;
when
we lose, we can't lose our confidence and strength' We can learn from
our failure. Actually there is no winner or loser in any sports games

items.q: Which of these sports events: football, basketball, volleyball, etc. do you play best?
items.cn: 足球、篮球、排球等运动中,你最擅长哪一项?
items.ans:
I can play
football /basketball /volleyball very we l. l started to play it when I was
very small and took part in the training course in a sports club.l learned
to play the game with the confidence of winning. But actually l couldn't
win all the time.Now l know there is something more significant than
winning a sports competition.

items.q: What position do you play?
items.cn: 你打什么位置?
items.ans:
lt depends on the sports events l take
part in.l play the goalkeeper in the football game, while in the basketball
game l play the defence. In the baseball game, I'm a catcher.In the
swimming competition, l don't have any positions because swimming is
different from games like football and basket.ball. So it's hard to define
exactly what position l play in the sports game.

items.cn: 你想让你的国 家主办奥运会吗?
items.ans:

Olympic Games is an international sports event. We can see a 'o t of
famous sports stars who will participate in the lympic Games.lt can also
benefit the development of economy in the country. So l think it's
necessary to host the Olympic Games.

items.q: Do you like animals?
items.cn: 你喜欢动物吗?
items.ans:
Yes,l like animals very much.l like
panda particularly. Panda is a kind of rare animals, We must protect it,
Protecting panda is protecting our environment.

items.q: Do you have pets?
items.cn: 你有饲养宠物 吗?
items.ans:
Yes,l have two pets:a cat and a rabbit. L love cats because they
are very gentle.My cat always sit son my table and looks at me when l do
my homework. My rabbit is very cute and always plays hide-and-seek
when l want to pet her. They are so lovely.Or: No, l don't like to keep
animals as pets. Some people think that they are very kind to animals
when they keep them as pets. But l think actually they are torturing
animals for they don't give animals freedom. Animals shouf livein the
natural world rather than live with people in the house.

items.q: Do you think we human beings should take animals as our friends?
items.cn: 你认为人类应该把动物当作我们的朋友吗?
items.ans:
Yes,l think we should take animals as our friends.We live in the
same natural world,so we should live harmoniously with wild animals. lf
there is n't any wild animals in the world, the balance of ecology will be
broken down There will be a lot of disasters. So we need to treat animals
as our friends.Or: No, I don't think we should take animals as our friends.
As we know, some animals are good to our environment, but others do
harm to our environment especially when they are overrun.l think
nobody likes to take rats o cock roaches as our friends. For animals like
these, we should eliminate them.

items.q: Which life do you prefer, city life or rural life?
items.cn: 你更喜欢城市生活,还是农村生 活?
items.ans:
l prefer city life than rural life.In city,life is more comfortable.l
can go any where l like because there is a good public transport system.l
can experience a lot of things that I haven't tried in the countryside. For
example,can go to the concert and cafª. City life is always more
interesting. So l like city life.
Or: l like countryside life. Country life is quiet and peaceful, not as noisy
and busy as city life.l can watch stars in the sky and hear soft buzzes of
insects in the evening.To build up my body,l can do some labour work in
the farm. Also,l can grow some crops or vegetables and l really enjoy my
work.Sol prefer to live in the countryside.

items.q: How do you travel to school?
items.cn: 你怎么去上学?
items.ans:
l go to school on foot.My home is rather close to my school. l
usually don't take a bus /car /train to school. It is very healthy to go to
school on foot because l can do physical exercises and it contributes to
environ-ment protection.
